characters.name: Professor Hooten
characters.greeting: Hello, curious friend! Come and see my clock wall.
characters.moment: At the library party, Professor Hooten shows the twins five clocks and leads the countdowns.
book: Cluck O’Clock and the Midnight That Came Early
characters.alt: A brown owl in round spectacles and a green waistcoat

characters.name: Hen-Berry
characters.greeting: Hello, dear! Would you like to help me fold a paper hat?
characters.moment: Hen-Berry makes a gold paper hat for Cluck and a green one for Coop. After the party, she pulls Cluck home on the sled.
book: Cluck O’Clock and the Midnight That Came Early
characters.alt: A red-feathered hen with a cream face and a cluster of berries and leaves

characters.name: Corgi-on-the-Cob
characters.greeting: Hi! Count the cobs with me. This time, help me remember to count myself!
characters.moment: Corgi sets off for Nutmeg’s harvest table with a basket of corn. Three friends help keep his feast on track.
characters.alt: An orange-and-white corgi with upright ears

characters.name: Cluck O’Clock
characters.greeting: Hello! My watch is ready. Are you staying up for midnight?
characters.moment: Cluck brings his brass pocket watch to the library. At the party he discovers that midnight arrives at different times around the world.
book: Cluck O’Clock and the Midnight That Came Early
characters.alt: A cream rooster with a red comb and a blue-green tail

characters.name: Coop-Accino
characters.greeting: Hi! Let’s count down together. I’ll start at three.
characters.moment: Coop wears the green paper hat and helps finish a countdown at the library with her twin, Cluck.
book: Cluck O’Clock and the Midnight That Came Early
characters.alt: A golden-brown chicken with a dark crest and a coffee-bean bandana

characters.name: Panda-Cake
characters.greeting: Hello! Come help me count what’s in my market basket.
characters.moment: At Nutmeg’s harvest feast, Panda-Cake brings rolls and helps cook the corn.
characters.alt: A cream-and-dark panda with a pancake wrap

animals.name: Giant panda
animals.fact: A special wrist bone helps a giant panda grip bamboo as it eats.

clues: I went to the New Year party at the library.
I’m one of a pair of twins.
I brought my brass pocket watch.
rounds.explanation: Cluck brought his brass pocket watch to the library party.

clues: I was at the library’s New Year party.
You’ll find me in the twins’ kitchen.
I folded a paper hat for each twin.
rounds.explanation: Hen-Berry folded gold and green paper hats for the twins.

clues: You’ll find me at the library’s New Year party.
I helped get the party ready for the countdown.
I’m the owl who showed everyone the five clocks on the wall.
rounds.explanation: Professor Hooten shows the twins how the five clocks work.
